contexts.text: A new Church then arose, which... is described by their sons Jabal, Jubal, and Tubal-Cain; the celestial things of the Church by Jabal...
Jabal the father of the dweller in tent and of cattle () = doctrine concerning the holy things of love, and concerning the goods thence, which are celestial things. AC 413.

That the holy things of love and the derivative goods are signified, may also be evident from this: that Jabal was not the first of the dwellers in tent and in folds of cattle; for it is said of Abel also... that he was a shepherd of the flock; and Jabal was the seventh in order from Cain.

That afterwards through faith the Holy of love and the good thence were given by the Lord, was signified by Jabal whom Adah bare; and that the Spiritual of faith was given, was signified by his brother Jubal; and that from these were natural good and truth, by Tubal-Cain, whom Zillah bare.
